name: KAPILA: Kalam Program for IP Literacy and Awareness (AICTE/MIC)
authority: Ministry of Education's Innovation Cell (MIC) & AICTE

other_conditions: Institute must have an active Institution's Innovation Council (IIC) or KAPILA portal registration
Application must be routed through and submitted by the college KAPILA/IIC coordinator, not individual students

benefit.description: Financial reimbursement of official patent application filing fees
benefit.notes: Reimbursement provided to the higher education institution upon successful submission and verification

documents_required: Invention disclosure form / patent specification draft
Institute authorization and IIC endorsement letter
application_steps: Student discloses invention to college IIC / IP cell coordinator
College IP committee reviews patentability and prior art
Institute coordinator files on the official KAPILA portal

name: Karnataka Startup Mission Patent Support
authority: Karnataka Innovation and Technology Society (KITS), Govt. of Karnataka

other_conditions: Applicant must be enrolled in an engineering institution in Karnataka
College must have an active IEDC / New Age Incubation Network (NAIN) center through which application is forwarded

benefit.description: Patent cost reimbursement and filing support for student inventions
benefit.notes: Cost reimbursement is routed and facilitated via the college IEDC / NAIN coordinator

documents_required: Provisional or complete patent draft specification
College IEDC / NAIN coordinator recommendation letter
application_steps: Present prototype to college IEDC coordinator
IEDC reviews technical viability and issues recommendation
IEDC submits application package to Karnataka Startup Cell portal

name: KSCST IP Technical Assistance
authority: Karnataka State Council for Science and Technology (KSCST)

other_conditions: Technical invention originated within a Karnataka academic institution

benefit.description: Technical assistance including prior-art search, patentability assessment, and filing advisory (no direct cash grant)
benefit.notes: Advisory support provided by KSCST Patent Information Centre (PIC) without direct financial disbursement

documents_required: Project technical summary and problem statement
application_steps: Contact KSCST Patent Information Centre (PIC) with technical summary
Participate in technical evaluation and prior-art search review with KSCST patent consultants
Receive advisory report on patentability and recommended drafting path

name: DST NIDHI-PRAYAS Student Prototype Grant
authority: Department of Science & Technology (DST), Govt. of India

benefit.description: Prototype grant support up to Rs. 10 Lakhs for converting student technical ideas into physical POCs
benefit.notes: Non-dilutive grant-in-aid disbursed via DST-supported Technology Business Incubators (TBIs)

documents_required: Prototype project proposal and technical roadmap
application_steps: Apply through nearest DST-recognized TBI or institutional incubator center
Pitch prototype viability to screening committee

name: SIPP: Scheme for Facilitating Start-Ups Intellectual Property Protection
authority: Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (CGPDTM)

benefit.description: 80% statutory fee rebate on patent filing and free advisory support from registered patent facilitators
benefit.notes: Applicable for student-faculty joint patents and recognized college innovation startups

application_steps: Select a registered IP Facilitator from the official IP India panel
Facilitator drafts and submits the patent application on the official IP India portal
